text_block_list.name: Girl with Dreadlocks
text_block_list.text: ...This is the venue, right...?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Family Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Welcome to the "Mejiro Christmas Night"!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"Thank you so much for coming! 
Please pick up your pamphlets at the log 
cabin reception!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
"Until the greeting begins, 
please feel free to enjoy the attractions 
and festivities~."

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Many Rings
text_block_list.text:
"Whoa, the atmosphere is insane! It's like 
the entire lineup of Mejiro Umamusume is 
here!"

text_block_list.name: Longtime Fan in Kimono
text_block_list.text:
"No, not everyone is here. Lady Mejiro 
Ardan and 
Lady Mejiro McQueen are both absent 
today."

text_block_list.name: Girl with Dreadlocks
text_block_list.text: "......Who was that? Just now."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"We will now begin the Mejiro Greeting! 
Please take your time and enjoy your 
moments with the Umamusume!"

text_block_list.name: Rocker Young Man
text_block_list.text: "YEAAAAAH!! WOOOOOOOOOO!"

text_block_list.name: Longtime Fan in Suit
text_block_list.text:
"!? ...I-It seems we have quite the lively 
fans this year..."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"—The Mejiro Greeting is currently 
underway. 
This is free time for you to interact with 
the Mejiro Umamusume."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"The locations of each Umamusume are 
marked on the park map, so please feel 
free to refer to it. That concludes the 
announcement. Please, enjoy yourselves."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"(...If it's just the reception desk, I 
think I can handle talking to guys. 
It feels pathetic that I can't do the 
greeting, though...)"

text_block_list.name: Girl with Dreadlocks
text_block_list.text:
"The Umamusume over here is... Mejiro 
Ryan? 
...Do you know her?"

text_block_list.name: Longtime Fan in Dress
text_block_list.text:
"Goodness! That's Ryan-san, you know?! 
You've never heard of her? 
She's an all-around great athlete among 
the Mejiro Umamusume, and so terribly 
cool!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"Heheh, I'm glad to hear that! Thanks for 
always cheering me on! 
And nice to meet you. I'm Mejiro Ryan! 
Great to meet ya!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"Say... you've got a great balance between 
your gastrocnemius and soleus muscles. 
Huh? Wait, aren't you the one who ran in 
the freestyle race with Dober!"

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Many Rings
text_block_list.text: "Huh!? You watched that race!?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"Yep! You ran so well, I've been wanting 
to talk to you! 
Hey, why don't we all sit down and chat!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: —My, there you are. You came after all.

text_block_list.name: Rocker Young Man
text_block_list.text:
"Huh? Me...? No, you must have the wrong 
person. 
This is my first time coming to one of 
these."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
"At the venue of the freestyle race. 
You were frolicking about with such 
innocence... it was adorable."

text_block_list.name: Rocker Young Man
text_block_list.text:
"Ghk!! ......I, too... I just couldn't 
forget that run of yours..."

text_block_list.name: Longtime Fan in Suit
text_block_list.text:
"Pardon me, what do you mean by a 
'freestyle race'? 
Did you run in one, Lady Ramonu?"

text_block_list.name: Rocker Young Man
text_block_list.text:
"Haven't you seen the video? Look at this! 
Lady Ramonu's running was just incredible, 
right?!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"...It's a little awkward, but doesn't 
seem like there are any major problems. 
We've got the riddle-solving treasure hunt 
coming up next, so we should be good!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
"Yes. I'm sure all our fans will work 
together and— 
...Oh my, it's snowing."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"Whoa! No wonder it felt so chilly~! 
...Oops, I'm getting a call from Dober."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"『Palmer, we have a big problem! Come 
back right now!』"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"—So according to the weather forecast, 
we're getting heavy snow after this? 
Even though the forecast said it would 
stay clear all night..."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"The rain clouds seem to be moving fast. 
They say it's already piling up in western 
Japan. 
The problem is... public transit. If it 
turns into a blizzard, it's gonna be total 
chaos."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
"Highway closures and planned transit 
suspensions are very likely, aren't they? 
Even if they do run, they will be terribly 
congested~."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"Hmm, for now let's consult the board 
members. 
Let's borrow the wisdom of the Mejiro 
family's battle-hardened brains!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"Brrr, so cold! The snow's really coming 
down! 
...Huh? Did something happen...?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: —It looks like it's going to pile up...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"Sorry to keep you waiting~! The Mejiro 
family says they'll arrange buses for 
everyone to head home! 
They'll arrive here in two hours."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
"So... we will have to wrap up the event 
in two hours, then."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"Two hours, huh... Most of the 
participants might not be able to clear 
the main riddle-solving treasure hunt..."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"—Then let's figure out a way to make it 
fun in two hours! 
Ending things on an awkward note isn't 
what any of us want, right?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
"...Indeed. If we only have two hours 
left, then all the more reason to ensure 
everyone has a wonderful and fulfilling 
time."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...So, what should we do...?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
"......Heh. 
You certainly are perseverant."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"...Because those two haven't given up 
yet. 
Besides—I believe we can make this work!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: —Let's change the rules of the game!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"Originally, only Bright and I were 
supposed to hold the hints for the 
riddles. 
If we add more Santas, it'll be way easier 
to find hints!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"...But wouldn't that make the riddles way 
too easy? 
I wonder if it'll make the game boring..."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
"That is true~. 
Riddles are more fun the more challenging 
they are, after all... —Ah."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
"How about raising the difficulty in 
another way? 
Like, having them answer a quiz before 
they can get a hint, for example."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"A quiz... ...Hey, that might work! 
And if they don't know the answer, they 
can help each other out!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"In that case, we need a quiz that's 
reasonably difficult, but with 
participants around who might know the 
answer—"

text_block_list.name: All Three
text_block_list.text: A Mejiro Family Quiz!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"Longtime fans will be able to answer 
right away, but it'll be tough for newer 
fans! 
If they rely on other participants, fans 
can cooperate with each other!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
"I am sure our fans will be delighted to 
put the knowledge they have gained from 
supporting us for so many years to good 
use~."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"On the flip side, finding the Santas 
gives an advantage to newer fans who are 
used to sharing info on social media. 
It feels like they'll balance each other 
out and help one another!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"Alright! Let's get started right away 
with these rules!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"—Have you decided on a plan? What should 
I do? 
Just give me the word, and I'll get right 
on it!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
"Ryan-onesama... ...Thank you very much. 
In that case, may we ask for your 
assistance?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"—And now, let the 'Find Santa & the 
Reindeer! 
Mystery Treasure Hunt' begin!!"

text_block_list.name: Participants
text_block_list.text:
"Whoa, look over there...! It's the Mejiro 
Santas!!"
